condition: For multigraphs, draw_networkx_edges picks each edge's entry from a connectionstyle list by its edge key instead of its position in the edge list, so parallel edges can get the wrong style and overlap.
workaround: Pass a connectionstyle list with one entry per multiedge index, its length being the largest number of parallel edges between any node pair. Or draw each node pair's multiedges in a separate draw_networkx_edges call.
